title: Projectile time correct
description: Essential Criteria: Student correctly uses vertical displacement H and gravitational acceleration g to find the time of flight t.

title: Initial velocity magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: Student correctly calculates the initial horizontal velocity v0 from the horizontal displacement x and the time of flight t.

title: Centripetal force relation
description: Important Criteria: Student identifies that the friction force provides the centripetal force at the point of slipping, setting μmg = m(v0^2)/R.

title: Friction coefficient calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student correctly solves for the coefficient of kinetic friction μ using the relation μ = v0^2/(gR).

title: Correct value substitution
description: Important Criteria: Student correctly substitutes the given numerical values (R, H, x, g) into the derived equations.

title: Units in final answer
description: Optional Criteria: Student includes correct units (m/s for velocity, dimensionless for μ) with their final numerical answers.

title: Confuses vertical/horizontal motion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student incorrectly uses the vertical height H in the horizontal displacement equation (x = v0*t) or vice-versa.

title: Sign error in projectile time
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student uses an incorrect kinematic equation for vertical fall (e.g., H = gt^2 instead of H = (1/2)gt^2).

title: Misidentifies centripetal force
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student incorrectly states the centripetal force formula (e.g., uses angular velocity incorrectly) or misidentifies the force causing it.
